name: quad-rotary-balance
$comment: Quadruple inverted pendulum on a rotary arm (Furuta): balance only, from a disturbed upright start (global th0_1..th0_4, deg) with a 50 ms tip push at 3 s. Plant: spatial multibond bond graph (Revolute3D arm joint about the vertical, four Revolute3D pendulum joints about the arm axis, 1e8 stiff holds, RigidBody3D arm and links), ideal torque on the arm with bearing friction and hub inertia. The firmware starts latched in the balance phase (balance_only).

options.text: **Balance only.** The chain starts near upright, leaning by the start angles below, and the 1 kHz LQR holds it. A tip push at 3 s (50 ms) tests the recovery. Change an input: then press **Run**. Try the actuator delay (1 ms steps), the quantised encoders, a heavier chain (the gains stay those of the nominal chain).
